concept: AWS Config: continuous configuration evaluation (public S3 buckets)
tests: Combination to detect a bucket policy change to public access and alert automatically.
expected: AWS Config managed rule s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited + an EventBridge rule on compliance change → SNS. Triggers: "detect when policy changed", "alerted automatically", (Choose two).
why_not: Shield Advanced is DDoS; Transfer Acceleration is upload speed; neither relates to detecting public access.
